# What does a decorated shirt actually cost you?

> Free screen printing, embroidery and DTF pricing calculator for custom apparel shops: work out your real cost per shirt from screens or digitising, press or stitch time, blanks and spoilage, then see the break-even price, the margin at what you quoted, and what the same job costs at 12, 24, 48, 72, 144 and 288 pieces.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
